title: Gun Seven: Swift Striker (fire rate) vs Enchanter's Emblem in the same slot
question: Does +20% fire rate (more Power Surge procs, one per burst) beat Enchanter's Emblem's +15 spirit, 18% spirit resist, 5% CDR and 1.6k health invest for this build?
hypothesis: H-N2: at 12k souls, gun+Power Surge damage in one Power Surge window is ~+22% with Swift Striker (calculated 7052 vs 5492-6307), but time to death vs a spirit bot is >= 15% shorter (HP 1518 vs 2166 calculated). Also tests whether Power Surge procs cap at ChainTickRate 0.2 s.

arms.name: EMBLEM
arms.notes: proposed at 12k (Enduring Speed approximated by Sprint Boots)

setup.position: 4 bots on a 300 u ring, main target 350 u

controls: Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
Same souls/level per arm; ability tiers set with abil ops per FOUNDATIONS F9 (unlocked 1, T1 3, T2 7, T3 15), logged before each block
Same bot heroes, positions, HP keep-alive and resists
procedure: cast 3; fire for the whole Power Surge window with reloads
count Power Surge procs per second from the damage csv
separate block: spirit bot casts at the player, time to death

metrics.name: window_damage_main
metrics.how: damage csv, main target, gun + Power Surge

decision.rule: SWIFT >= +15% damage AND time_to_death loss < 15% would reopen Swift Striker; otherwise keep Enchanter's Emblem
